blocks.text: VATICAN CITY, Holy See – Pope Leo’s trip to South America next month will go ahead as planned, the Vatican said Monday, confirming the papal visit nearly two weeks after the pontiff’s lung-cancer surgery. “The Holy See Press Office confirms that the Apostolic Journey of Pope Leo XIV to Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru, scheduled for 6–17 November 2026, will proceed according to the programme previously published,” said the Vatican in a note....
